route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hbm_su_bridge_release_1018/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hbm_su_bridge_release_1018/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

notes: release S+14q (negedge E0-2q) in the same [E0-3q,E0) window; bridge_rst_n/fault now serial-domain outputs
structural_change: RBH-SFUS 10-18 r2 hold fix vs r1-cd685d69e (NEEDS_RTL: FF hold -71.6 ps on b_s(clk_serial) -> s1(clk_stream)): on the 3:4 lattice a serial->stream flop pair has a 0-ps common-edge hold relation and a 1q (278 ps) setup relation, which the distinct-entry reserve (setup 150 / hold 100) cannot both meet (a stream-negedge capture probe gave 0.5q both ways: gate setup -83 ps). New master ot_hbm_su_bridge_release_s: ONE clock (serial), release from a serial negedge flop at E0-2q (inside [E0-3q,E0), recovery 2q to E0); release S+14q (was S+13q), same first edge E0 for both bridge domains; bench vs the ideal release on two real multirate bridges PASS, misaligned restart faults, 2 mutants fail. rst_stream_n/clk_stream ports gone.
